svg.aria-label: Geographic map of California’s rail service goals and gray existing Amtrak inventory. Use the corridor list for an accessible text alternative.

g.text: N E V A D A
A R I Z O N A
HSR red · intercity blue · regional green · integrated bus gray
Thicker targets = more frequent. Dotted gray = bus. Dashed = generalized.
Fine gray Amtrak = 2024 inventory. Not a timetable or funding award.
